subject: test(material/chips): remove dependency on NoopAnimationsModule (#31791)
reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: Removes the private chip-grid NoopAnimationsModule import. The owned chip-list spec already has no such import and uses a public core token provider.
Drops the next-item test module argument/TODO and moves focus from the chip to a patched primary action followed by mark/render. Keep the legacy chip-host focus and next active-index assertion.
Drops the previous-item test module argument/TODO and moves focus to the patched last primary action followed by mark/render. Keep the legacy host focus and previous active-index assertion.
Drops the unfocused-grid removal test module argument/TODO. Keep the analogous owned host blur/zone-exit/no-active-item test; do not substitute a grid/action fixture.
Drops the final-item grid-focus test module argument/TODO. Keep the owned legacy list-focus fallback assertion.
Drops the module argument from the modern primary focus-indicator query. Legacy host structure/classes are preserved; no modern focus-indicator selector is introduced.
Drops the module argument/TODO from a FormFieldChipGrid active-chip deletion test. The owned legacy chip/form and host-focus coverage remains required; this is not evidence of execution.

Drops the module argument/TODO from removal via a secondary chip-grid action. Preserve the retained legacy removal/focus cases. Neither the existing token marker nor this source decision establishes real animated-host or native-focus behavior.

decision: The eight original chip-grid hunks remove one NoopAnimationsModule import and seven explicit module arguments. Six associated TODO comments are removed; the first two focus-removal tests additionally focus patched modern primary-action elements and mark/render before deleting the chip. The owned legacy chip list has analogous next/previous/blur/list fallback removal checks, but focus goes through the chip host and FocusKeyManager. Its owned spec already uses an ANIMATION_MODULE_TYPE provider instead of that engine NgModule. Exact Core21.2.23/22.1.7 public declarations mark this token public without deprecation; no token migration follows from the module removal. Do not transplant modern primary-action selectors, fake focus setup or a chip-grid contract into legacy controls. Preserve all legacy cases and host-focus assertions. The token marker is not an animation engine or actual animated-host/native-focus proof; those obligations remain pending.
